Dennis Edward Skinner (born 11 February 1932) is a British politician who served as Member of Parliament (MP) for Bolsover for 49 years, from 1970 to 2019. [ 1 ] A member of the Labour Party , he is known for his left-wing views and republican sentiments. [ 2 ] Before entering Parliament, he worked for more than 20 years as a coal miner .
